summary.name: Porting Kit
summary.one_liner: Porting Kit is a free macOS tool that uses Wineskin technology to install and run Windows games and apps on a Mac.
use_cases: Installing Windows games on a Mac
Following a tutorial to port a Windows game to macOS
summary.what_it_does: Porting Kit uses Wineskin technology to install games and apps compiled for Microsoft Windows on macOS. The page describes it as free and simple to use. It offers a download, a forum, a news section, and a comparison page that names Wineskin and CrossOver. A tutorial is linked for users who find it hard to use. The page gives no details on specific supported titles, system requirements, or how installation works beyond this.
notable: Has a comparison page against Wineskin and CrossOver
Includes a step-by-step tutorial and forum
caveats: Page gives no system requirements or supported version details
Page does not describe which Windows games or apps are supported
